sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body: When you use the Kizora website, we collect information including your name, email address, phone number, and delivery address when you place an order or create an account.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use your information to process orders, provide customer support, send order updates, and improve our services. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

sections.heading: 3. Data Security
sections.body: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information. All sensitive data is encrypted and stored securely.

sections.heading: 4. Contact Us
sections.body: If you have any questions about our Privacy Policy, please contact us at hello@kizora.com.bd.
